articles.title: Trump Called Out for 'Unhinged' Attack on Abdul El-Sayed After Prez Brands Michigan Senate Candidate a 'Jihadist Lunatic Who Hates Our Country'
articles.description: President Donald Trump called Michigan Democratic Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed a 'Jihadist lunatic' in a post after Thursday's debate.
articles.content:
